name: Hunyuan3D 2.1 Full - Low VRAM
description: Full Hunyuan Shape 2.1 (3.3B, no Mini/Turbo and no Paint), with low-RAM mmap/meta loading and native GLB export in Modly.
author: AlefK1708

params_schema.label: Mesh Precision
params_schema.tooltip: Quantization is performed locally at runtime. INT8 uses less RAM; FP16 preserves the original weights but relies heavily on the Windows page file.

params_schema.label: Quality
params_schema.tooltip: More steps increase generation time; every option still uses the full Hunyuan3D 2.1 model.

params_schema.label: Mesh Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Reconstruction at 384 can run out of VRAM on complex geometry. Start at 256.

params_schema.label: Reconstruction Memory
params_schema.tooltip: Batch size used by the volume decoder. Reduce it to 2000 if the final stage runs out of CUDA memory.

params_schema.label: Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: Controls adherence to the input image. The official Hunyuan3D 2.1 default is 5.0.

params_schema.label: Remove Background
params_schema.tooltip: Uses rembg on the CPU. PNG images that already contain transparency are not processed again.
